Paris Gentle Mates (previously Los Angeles Guerrillas and Los Angeles Guerrillas M8) is the team representing Paris, France, in the Call of Duty League. The team is owned by Gentle Mates. On December 4th, 2024, Gentle Mates announced they had acquired the Los Angeles Guerrillas franchise, rebranding it to Los Angeles Guerrillas M8.[1] On November 26th, 2025, the team relocated to Paris, France, rebranding to Paris Gentle Mates.[2]
